champions.name: Renata Glasc
champions.tldr: Innate: Renata's basic attacks mark enemies for 6 seconds, dealing 1–5.25%|health (+ 1% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage if they were unmarked.; Allied champions damaging attacks and abili…
champions.gameplayImpact: Renata Glasc was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Renata's basic attacks mark enemies for 6 seconds, dealing 1–5.25%|health (+ 1% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage if they were unmarked.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Allied champions damaging attacks and abilities against marked targets consume the mark to deal 1–5.25%|health (+ 1% per 100 AP) of their maximum health as additional bonus magic damage|magic damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Attacking a marked enemy will only refresh their mark's duration. Marking a different enemy will remove the mark from the previous target. Leverage's damage is capped at 150 against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Renata fires a hook out from her robotic arm in the target direction, dealing 80–260 (+ 80% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit and root them for 1 second, during which they are standard sight and Renata is unable to declare attacks and has her movement speed reduced by 30%|ms. Handshake can be recast while the target is rooted.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Renata airborne the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through and stun them for 0.5 seconds if the thrown target is a champion.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Range: cr / , Width: er , Speed: / , Cast Time: 0.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Renata enhances herself or the target allied champion for 5 seconds, granting the target 10–30% (+ 1% per 100 AP) bonus attack speed in addition to 10–20% (+ 1% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed while they are moving toward nearby sight enemy champions and minions, both increasing in effectiveness by 100% over the duration. Bailout's duration resets whenever the target scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If the target takes death while Bailout is active, they are restored to 100% of their maximum health but begin burning to take true damage equal to 8. every until they die from reaching 0 health. If they score a takedown against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them while suffering from the burn, it is stopped prematurely and they are set to 35% of their maximum health. This effect may only occur once per application of Bailout while not already active on the target.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Target Range: cr 800, Effect Radius: cr , Cast Time: None.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Renata sends out a chemtech rocket from either side of her that instantly strike targets around her. After they converge and travel to the target location as a single missile, striking targets along its path and exploding upon reaching its target location.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Renata and allies struck are granted a 50–130 (+ 50% AP) shield for 3 seconds and enemies struck are dealt 65–185 (+ 55% AP) magic damage and are slow by 30% for 2 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Target Range: 800, Effect Radius: cr / , Width: er , Speed: , Cast Time: 0.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Renata launches a cloud of potent chemicals that spreads out in the target direction, which grants sight of its surroundings and turns all enemy champions and minions it passes over berserk for 1.25–2.25 (3 ranks) seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Berserk causes afflicted targets to go insane, granting them 100% bonus attack speed and increased size, and forcing them to basic attack the nearest unit, regardless of being allied, enemy, or neutral. They prioritize attacking their own allies, then neutral units, then Renata's allies, then Renata herself.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Renata gains kill credit of enemies killed by their berserked allies through their basic attacks. Berserked units can be forced to attack all units except turret.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Range: cr , Effect Radius: sight , Width: er , Angle: , Speed: , Cast Time: 0.75 seconds.
